title: Perfect Inventory - Organization Puzzle
description:
WISHLIST OUR UPCOMING GAME!

Об игреYour goal is to perfectly fit all the items into the inventory without leaving any empty space.
To do so, you have some features that can be useful:

Drag and Rotate:

Assembling and disassembling items makes the game more versatile and challenging:

Bags, Backpacks and Chests can be used as containers to make room to fit more items:
Featuring• More than hand-drawn 100 items to organize and fit.

• 50 handcrafted levels.

• Relaxing medieval music to make you feel the atmosphere.
description_short: Perfect Inventory is an organization puzzle game that brings you to a medieval age in the role of a methodical squire trying to make his best to fit all the items perfectly into the inventory.
